_note: Maintainer rulings 2026-10-15/16 on main sentences whose source text prints alternatives. Applied by split_alternatives.py in place of its automatic resolution; source_form is the record's original FORM after source repairs, and the build fails if it no longer matches. publish lists the exact S records (forms[0] is the base FORM, later forms are ver="alt"; an empty translations list publishes no TRANSL). audio: 'untranscribed' puts the record's recordings at TEXT level (the source printed alternatives), 'on_S' keeps them in the S.

rulings_key.retain: one S, printed text kept with its parentheses, translation as printed
rulings_key.remove: one S, the parenthesised content removed; translation as printed (Thao_2520: 我自己種的稻子)
rulings_key.b: two S, same translation; second id <id>-opt
rulings_key.c: one S, base FORM + ver="alt" FORM
rulings_key.a: two S, each with its own translation
rulings_key.delete: no S; recording published as untranscribed audio
rulings_key.thao-one-form: Thao one-to-many split: one S, the parenthetical deleted
rulings_key.thao-alt-variant: Thao one-to-many split: one S with the given ver="alt" reading
